action: The DSK advises controllers to keep IT security systems up to date and to make staff aware of data protection and data security.
date_note: The Rhineland-Palatinate commissioner's page, dated 26 November 2026, gives no earlier day for the press release.
exec: Germany's data protection authorities, meeting as the DSK, say they will examine how data protection and cybersecurity support each other.
plain: Germany's data protection authorities, meeting as the DSK in late November 2026, say they see a rise in data protection incidents and will work on guidance linking data protection and cybersecurity.

sources.name: Rhineland-Palatinate data protection commissioner: Datenschutzkonferenz: Mit Datenschutz zur besseren Cybersicherheit

summary: At its 112th conference, held in late November 2026, the Datenschutzkonferenz said the supervisory authorities see a rise in data protection incidents, including many IT security incidents. It plans to examine the synergies and tensions between data protection and cybersecurity and to draft guidance on endpoint protection.
title: German DSK says data protection can improve cybersecurity, plans endpoint protection guidance

validation.note: The Rhineland-Palatinate data protection commissioner's own page relaying the DSK press release was read; the DSK's own page was not opened.

review.note: title, date 26.11, 112th conference, rise in incidents, endpoint guidance, action checked against RLP commissioner page
